summary: Moggill Road shopfront kerb under trees; no real stopping room, 2P signs.
reasons: Line runs along shopfront and footpath
No clear room to pull off the lane

drivers.seclusion: Shopping centre frontage and shops opposite; no homes within 20 m but the spot is public and overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Line follows a footpath and landscaped edge beside the shopping centre, then a narrow road kerb at a junction; no room to stop off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road main road with a junction and moving traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P parallel Mon-Fri and Saturday daytime signs; no overnight pattern.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the line.
